desc:
🍀 Welcome to TOWER OF LUCK! ⚔️

One tower. Random items. One last player standing.

🏗️ Build your way to safety with blocks that arrive throughout the round, before the rising lava catches you!
⚔️ Battle your rivals, launch fireballs, and send players flying with snowballs!
❓ Break Lucky Blocks for surprises: a wishing well, a stack of pigs, or a brand-new pillar that launches you skyward!
🪙 Earn coins for kills and victories, then open crates to collect animated sword skins, capes, and legendary dragon wings.
🌙 NEW: The Scythe Bundle! Unlock the Nightfall Scythe and Moonveil Cape.
⬆️ Upgrade your Sword, Defense, and Luck.
🏆 Climb the wins and kills leaderboards and claim your place at the top!

💀 Knocked out? Respawn on your pillar and get back in the fight!
🗿 Grab a Totem of Undying from behind your pillar for a second chance.

Your sword skin is cosmetic, so pick your favorite look and make it yours.

🎁 Come back for daily rewards!
🎡 Spin the wheel for free every day!
